title: The Luxury of Being Known
gist: BCG's 2026 Experiential Luxury Survey (436 qualified respondents across North America, Europe and Asia) finds luxury brands lose value when customer knowledge fails to travel between visits, channels and service: 34% of returning clients are treated as new, 43% get no post-purchase follow-up, and 30% find profiles don't carry across locations. The prescription is a portable unified customer profile and AI that equips associates behind the scenes rather than replacing them, with the physical store kept central.
